description: If an arithmetic formula holds at every assignment in every model of PA, its universal closure has a PA derivation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.derives_allClose_of_models {α : Type} [Fintype α]
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula α)
  (h : ∀ (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA.ModelType) (v : α → ↑M), φ.Realize v) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose φ)
